label: UFiber Instant GPON CPE (SFP form factor)
description: GPON ONU built into an SFP module: an SC/APC PON port (2.488 Gbit/s down, 1.244 Gbit/s up) on the outside, and a 1G SGMII host interface on the SFP edge connector that plugs straight into a switch cage. There is no RJ45 anywhere on the unit.
